main_answer_reason: The report reconstructs the two appellate tracks, earlier and later deduction requests, opposed trial/District Judge/High Court dispositions, and proposed munafa grounds without inventing a final Supreme Court outcome. It omits material land-tenure origins, Wasilat and rent-assessment terms, distinct District Judge rationales, interest, and unresolved first-batch chronological and accounting tensions. Its opening claim that the batches involved the same parties is wrong, and its suggested High Court rationale lacks support in the allowed excerpts. The narrative also blurs which court granted leave to appeal.
